braidense:VEAE144693.description_en: The Corpus Hermeticum ("collection of the works of Hermes") is a collection of philosophical-religious writings of the imperial period (2nd-3rd century AD) attributed to Hermes Trismegistus. braidense:MILE062620.description_en: The Liber de proprietatibus rerum is an encyclopedia of the Scholastic Bartholomaeus Anglicus (c. 1190–1250), who wrote the work in Magdeburg in the 13th century. It is divided into 19 systematically structured books.

braidense:RMRE001716.description_en: The Hypnerotomachia Poliphili, literally The Amorous Combat of Poliphilo in a Dream, is an allegorical novel, printed in Venice by Aldo Manuzio the Elder in December 1499, with 169 xylographic illustrations.

braidense:CAGE000355.description_en: The Chronicles of Nuremberg are a compilatory work by Hartmann Schedel, written in Latin in 1493. It is an illustrated history of the world, which follows biblical narration; the book also contains the history of many of the great cities of the West.
